decisions.reason: The mitred lever family is part of the firm's coordinated design range, involved real tooling investment and is still listed. Little evidence of failure exists, so management has no reason to write it off.

Promoting the multifunctional handle to its own page in 2024 is a visible, growing commitment. That fits the firm's announced barrier-free and hygiene direction, which makes dropping it very unlikely.

The single lever handle is still mentioned and costs little to keep in a broad certified range. Even if its uptake is modest, that can be put down to temporary market softness, so management keeps it.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection is publicly showcased with German Design and iF awards. Heavy investment and public commitment make withdrawing it practically unthinkable.
